_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
O tshameka Klondike Solitaire. Sepheo sa gago ke go tsamaya dikarata tsotlhe kwa mafelo a thekiso.

Melao ya Tshameko:
- Mafelo a thekiso (F1-F4): Aga gore go tle go tloga ka Ace go ya go King ka letsogo
- Mafelo a tafole (T1-T7): Aga kwa tlase ka go fetofetoga mebala (mokgwa o mosweu mo go mokgwa o moshibidu, mokgwa o moshibidu mo go mokgwa o mosweu)
- Tsamaiso: Tshwara dikarata go ya kwa mafelo a makgwakgwa
- Makgwakgwa (W): Karata e e godimo e kgona go tshamekiwa

Ditaelo:
- 'draw' - Tshwara dikarata go tswa kwa tsamaiso go ya kwa makgwakgwa
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Tsamaya dikarata kwa gare ga mafelo
  Mekwalo: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. palo e ka nna le 'all', e e tla leka go tsamaya dikarata tsotlhe tse di bonwang.
- 'forfeit' - Khutlisa tshameko ka bonako le go kgwega sephelo sa gago sa jaanong
- Maina a mafelo: W (makgwakgwa), F1-F4 (mafeldo a thekiso), T1-T7 (mafeldo a tafole)

O ka dira ditiro tse dintsi ka go arola ka dikoma:
  Sekwalo: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Fela dikgosi fela tse di ka bewang kwa mafelo a tafole a a sa nang.
Ditiro di dirwa ka tatelano - fa e le gore e mongwe e palelwa, ditiro tse di setseng di tlaolwa.
Tumisa 'forfeit' fa o dumela gore tshameko e si ya kgonega go wina.

format_error.no_brackets: Sebopego sa tiro se ne se le phoso. Tiro e tshwanetse go nna mo dikopaneng tse di fa gare ga ditshipi.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Sebopego sa tiro se se seng molaong. Go tlhaela kholomo ya go tswala ']'
format_error.empty_command: Taelo e se na sepe. Tsenya 'draw' kgotsa 'move <source><destination> [count]'
format_error.move_needs_args: Taelo ya tsamaya e tlhoka motswedi le legae la tsamaya. Tumiso: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Palo e tshwanetse go nna e e siameng kgotsa 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Palo e e sa siamang. Tumia palo kgotsa 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Taelo e seng tlhokegilego '{cmd}'. Tsaya 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', or 'forfeit'

action_result.before_failure: Go diragatswa ga tiro ya {n} pele e retelelwa.

move_result.drew: O ne a ntsha karata ya gagwe go tswa mo lebokosong la dithoto tse di setseng.
move_result.cannot_draw: Ga go na sepe se re ka se ntshang, ga go na dijo tse di setseng.
move_result.invalid_pile: Leina la mokgobo ga le a dira. Dirisa W, F1-F4, kgotsa T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: O ka kgona go sutisa karata e le 1 fela mo mothong yo o nang le motheo.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Karata e ne ya fudusiwa go tswa mo matlakaleng a mangwe mme ya isiwa kwa motheong F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Ga o kake wa sutisetsa karata ya matlakala kwa thothobolong eo e kgolo
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Karte e tsamaisitswe go tswa tableau T{src} go ya foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Ga o kgone go sutisetsa karata ya tafole kwa thotobolong eo e kgolo.
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Ga e kgone go tsamaya fa gare ga motheo le o mongwe.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: O ka kgona go sutisa karata e le nngwe fela mo tafoleng ya matlakala.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Karata e ne ya fudusiwa go tswa mo matlakaleng a dilo tse di latlhilweng go ya kwa tafoleng T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Ga o kgone go baya karata ya matlakala mo mokgokoloseng oo wa tafole.
move_result.no_face_up: Ga go na dikarata tse di ka sutisiwang.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Tsamaisitswe {count} karte(s) go tswa tableau T{src} go ya T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Ga go kgonege go tsamaya dikarata {count} go T{src} go T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: O ka kgona go sutisa karata e le 1 fela go tswa mo setlhomong go ya kwa tafoleng.
move_result.foundation_empty: Motheo F{src} ga o na sepe.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Karte e tsamaisitswe go tswa foundation F{src} go ya tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Ga o kake wa baya karata ya motheo mo tafoleng T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Ga o kake wa fudusediwa kwa matlakaleng kgotsa mo setokong.

outcome.forfeit: Papadi e ne ya latlhwa.Palo ya bofelo: {score} dikarata mo metheong.
outcome.won: O fentse kgaisano ya Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Metswedi e fedile! O tlhakane le palo ya {max_turns} ditlhogo. Legato: {score} dikarata mo mafundishong.
